result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: the fixed bottom navigation overlaps the feed, cutting off the lower restaurant card and hiding content that should be reachable on screen.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar covers part of the 'Popular right now' content, leaving the lower restaurant card partially hidden and visually cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/inset to the scrollable content so items render above the fixed navigation bar, or make the bottom bar non-overlapping.
